# JEA BizDev Consulting

Strategic business development advisory for biotech and biopharma companies, led by John Adamou, MS, MBA. Focus: partnerships across North America, Europe, and Asia.

- [Services](https://jeabizdev.com/services): Strategy, partner identification, diligence, deal structuring, negotiation, and engagement options.
- [About](https://jeabizdev.com/about): John Adamou's background and transaction experience.
- [Approach](https://jeabizdev.com/approach): Working process and frequently asked questions.
- [Opportunities](https://jeabizdev.com/assets): Partnering assets. Confirm current availability and scientific details directly with JEA.
- [Transactions](https://jeabizdev.com/transactions): Client announcements and historical deal summaries.
- [Tools](https://jeabizdev.com/tools): Sixteen illustrative business development calculators with formulas and assumptions.
- [Contact](https://jeabizdev.com/contact): Non-confidential inquiries and overview deck requests.
